open.speaker: kb
open.text: Welcome, welcome! Freshers eat first, that's the rule. KB — Business, Level 400, future SRC president, if God and the voters agree. And you are?

choices.text: Is this a party or a campaign rally?

both.speaker: kb
both.text: Both! On this campus everything is both. Eat first, judge later. What's your name?

room.speaker: kb
room.text: And which hall? Let me guess — Block A, you have the Block A face.

choices.text: I've seen your face before. In a photo.

a214.speaker: kb
a214.text: A-214. …Nice room. Lucky room. Good view of the field — enjoy it while it's still a field.

photo.speaker: kb
photo.text: Everybody says that. I have one of those faces — posters, flyers, you know. Which hall are you in?

a214-quiet.speaker: kb
a214-quiet.text: …A-214. Okay. Okay. Eat, my friend. We'll talk properly another time.

end.speaker: kb
end.text: And if a lady with a clipboard tries to recruit you outside — that's Selasi. Smart. Wrong about everything, but smart.
